text.label: Add/Edit Ramp Marshall
To add a new Ramp Marshall
1) Use [shift+ctrl] and mouse left click on the
location where you want the aircraft to stop.
2) Activate the newly added Marshall with
a left click on the Marshall or hash marks.
3) Use the sliders to fine tune the
location and orientation of the Marshall.
4) Click on the "Save Current Edit" button
to save the new Marshall edits.
To edit an existing Ramp Marshall
1) Activate the Marshall you want to edit
with a left click.
2) Use the sliders to fine tune the
location and orientation of the Marshall.
3) Click on the "Save Current Edit" button
to save the edited Marshall.
